## Statements

- Stated by vendor (google-gemma-4-card, Best Practices, Thinking Mode Configuration): Gemma 4 thinking is a switch, not levels. Put the think token in the system turn to turn it on; leave it out to turn it off. There is no effort setting.
- Stated by vendor (google-gemma-4-formatting, Managing Thought Context Between Turns): Remove the model's thought text from earlier turns before sending history back. Keep it only within one turn that makes tool calls.
- Stated by vendor (google-gemma-thinking, A single text inference with Thinking, note): The 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B models may still open an empty thought block, or a real one, with thinking off; the chat template adds an empty block to steady them.
- Stated by vendor (google-gemma-4-card, Best Practices, Sampling Parameters): Use one sampling setting for every task: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64.
- Stated by vendor (google-gemma-4-card, Best Practices, Modality order): With images and text, put the image before the text; put audio after the text.
- Stated by vendor (google-gemma-4-formatting, Tip: Adaptive Thought Efficiency using System Instructions): To spend fewer thinking tokens, ask for brief thinking in the system instruction; the vendor measured about 20 percent fewer, and calls it a proof of concept.
